title: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority – AI Summit
summary: Liverpool's 2024 AI Summit planned interactive digital humans to assist attendees and host proceedings. Easier access to event information remains an intended benefit without a measured outcome.
account: The Liverpool City Region Combined Authority announced that multilingual, interactive digital humans would assist visitors and host its November 21, 2024 AI Summit. Supplier Sum Vivas named the assistants Ava, Alison, and James. The accounts provide no measurements of changes in access to event information, language barriers, or organizers' workload. The assistants' contribution to attendance and investment interest is unknown.
purpose: Help summit attendees access information through multilingual AI interaction and support event hosting.
system: Sum Vivas AI-integrated digital humans Ava, Alison, and James
deployer: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority and Sum Vivas

ratings.reason: Attendees are intended to receive multilingual AI assistance. Improvements in access to event information and visitor experience are unmeasured.
